en-us.lead: Keep your keys and tokens at hand, in your personal Vault.
en-us.connect: Sign in with my SSH agent
en-us.connect.help: Sign in with your SSH key (Pageant or ssh-agent), like vauth. The session is renewed automatically.
en-us.intro.place.text: The variables your tools already find with venv.
en-us.intro.key.text: Choose the public key of your agent that signs you in to Vault.
en-us.secrets.title: My secrets
en-us.profile.title: Profile
en-us.ssh.title: My SSH public key
en-us.ssh.help: This key lets your SSH agent sign you in to Vault. Never paste a private key.
en-us.ssh.publish.help: Publishing replaces the public keys of your SSH role. The Terraform/GitLab sync may restore them later.
en-us.editor.name: Variable name
en-us.editor.help: The name is saved in upper case, as with vauth.
en-us.empty.vault: Your vault is ready. Add your first secret.
en-us.copied.secret: Value copied. Remember to clear your clipboard after use.

en-us.ssh.status.none: No public key currently authorized on your Vault role.
en-us.exists: This variable already exists. Use Edit.
en-us.ssh.publish.confirm: Replace the public keys of your SSH role with this key?
en-us.ssh.published: Public key published. Your SSH agent can now sign in with vauth.
en-us.update.dev: Development build: no automatic update. Install a signed release once, it then updates itself.
en-us.update.dev.notice: Development build: install %s from the release page.
en-us.update.uptodate: vauth desktop %s is up to date (channel %s: %s).
en-us.err.restart: restart vauth desktop to use the new version
